tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Anclum's catalogue of MCP servers, agent skills and open-source AI projects, plus AI tools for people who are not developers. Returns name, url, one-line summary and tags. Read-only.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one catalogue entry by its key (the slug used in its Anclum URL). Returns the full record: name, url, description, tags, source, first/last seen. Read-only.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the catalogue's taxonomies: AI-tool categories (with counts) and field tags (e.g. "MCP 服务", "Agent 技能"). Useful for then calling search_tools with a category. Read-only.
